title: Affordable Housing on Private Land (Combined Reg 30(A) + 33(20)(B))
note: Verified against Sea Pebbles CHS Bandra (1218 sqm), Malad Dindoshi CTS 82B (20,234 sqm), JAI GIRNAR Tardeo (3346 sqm cross-scheme). Composite scheme: 30(A) base stack + 33(7)(B) incentive + 33(20)(B) additional (50/50 owner/AH split). Total permissible FSI capped at 4.00 + 35% fungible = 5.40.
scope: Private plot developer voluntarily allocates 50% of DCPR-additional FSI to construct Affordable Housing (AH) tenements handed over free-of-cost to MCGM. In return, gets equal 50% additional FSI for own sale component, over-and-above regular Reg 30(A) permissible.

base_stack_reg_30A.description: Standard Reg 30(A) FSI stack applied to net plot area after all deductions

additional_govt_fsi_on_premium.regulation_ref: Reg 30(A)(1)(A) — chargeable at 60% of ASR land rate

incentive_33_7_B.description: Additional BUA for 30+ year old buildings (Reg 33(7)(B)) — reduces the General TDR the developer must purchase.
incentive_33_7_B.treatment: Deducted from General TDR purchase requirement (developer gets it 'free' — no TDR purchase cost)

road_setback_advantage.description: Setback area merged with DP road — counted ONCE as BUA (not multiple times across FSI sources).
road_setback_advantage.formula: setback_area_sqm (BUA credit equal to setback area)

additional_33_20B_split.description: After base 30(A) stack, developer opts into 33(20)(B) which unlocks the remaining FSI up to 4.00 cap, split 50/50 owner/AH.

formula.ah_handover: AH tenements built by developer, handed over free-of-cost to MCGM

fungible_35pct.description: Reg 31(3) — 35% fungible over-and-above the permissible FSI. Applied to BOTH owner (sale) and AH components.
